Installation day

The plan, step by step

Installation at 27350 Echo Canyon Court Corona California 92883. Inside the garage, on the same wall directly behind the main panel. All installations are completed in a single day.

1

Easy access, zero disruption

We only need access to your garage and the electrical panel — no access inside your home is required (unless your project includes attic/crawlspace runs or an interior panel). And the power stays ON the entire time: we never shut off electricity to your home during the installation. Bonus: if you can give us remote garage access (keypad code or smart opener), you don't even need to be home — total flexibility on scheduling.

2

New dedicated breaker

A 40-amp breaker is installed exclusively for your charger — nothing else shares this circuit.

3

Wiring & conduit

<5 ft of ¾" EMT conduit · #6 THHN copper + #10 ground — routed clean and to code.

4

Mount & connect

Your Tesla Wall Connector is mounted inside the garage, on the same wall directly behind the main panel, between 24in and 5ft above the parking surface per NEC 625.

5

Load management install

We install and commission the DCC Load Management System at your panel. Its current transformers watch your home’s real-time usage; if the total nears your panel’s capacity the charger pauses, then automatically resumes once your home quiets down.

6

Tesla Commissioning

We energize and commission your Tesla Wall Connector, connect it to your Wi-Fi (when signal strength at the charger location allows), and upload your installation records as Tesla Certified Installers for warranty purposes.

The technical bit — made simple

How the power flows

Live diagram of your circuit: 100A Bryant Main Panel → new 40A dedicated breaker → <5 ft of ¾" EMT conduit · #6 THHN copper + #10 ground → Tesla Wall Connector → Tesla Vehicle. The DCC Load Management (blue) continuously monitors your panel’s total load and automatically adjusts charging so the panel never exceeds capacity.
Capacity verified

Over capacity — solved with DCC load management

The NEC load calculation shows your panel is over capacity with the charger added — so this installation includes a DCC Load Management System that makes it safe and code-compliant.

Terms & conditions

Re-scheduling, cancellations & scope changes
This estimate is based on the information provided at the time of quoting; actual scope may change based on site conditions. If the scope changes due to new information or requested modifications, additional charges may apply.

If the final location of the charger is changed on-site, a re-schedule may be necessary depending on the additional work needed — we typically run multiple installations per day and need to stay on schedule for every client.

Re-schedule fee$150.00
Cancellation within 24 hrs of install$200.00
Permits, HOA & local requirements
Local permitting and inspection requirements vary by city and county. It is the homeowner's responsibility to confirm whether a permit is required by their AHJ (Authority Having Jurisdiction).

Permit service is optional and listed as a separate line item in your estimate. If you request a city permit, Faraday Electric is responsible for obtaining the permit and coordinating all required inspections. If permit service is not selected, the homeowner assumes full responsibility for any permitting and inspection requirements.

Important: payment is required regardless of whether a city inspection has been completed. Inspection scheduling is handled by the city and may take days or weeks depending on availability — this is outside of Faraday Electric's control and does not affect the payment obligation.

Homeowners are responsible for complying with any applicable HOA rules or approval processes related to EV charger installations.

Warranty limitations
The warranty is void if another electrician or third party modifies the installation before Faraday Electric has the opportunity to inspect or repair. This includes panel work, added breakers, or rerouted wiring that affects the original installation.
Service calls
Verified installation-related warranty repairsNo charge
Issue not installation-related$250 diagnostic fee

Additional repair fees may apply. Replacement charger installations are not covered under warranty — if the manufacturer supplies a new unit, standard labor rates apply. Wi-Fi and connectivity issues are not covered under warranty.
